description: Java class defining REST API endpoints for generating PDF and CSV reports related to employees and metrics, secured with role-based access control.

classes.name: ReportsController
classes.description: Controller class handling report-related API endpoints, generates downloadable report files for employees and metrics with security annotations.

methods.name: employeesPdf
methods.description: Generates a PDF report listing all employees.

methods.name: employeePdf
methods.description: Generates a PDF report for a specific employee, identified by ID.

methods.name: metricsCsv
methods.description: Generates a CSV export of all metrics.
